summary: Frontend-only regression for dashboard redesign + homepage hero size fix. Verified on BOTH web and Expo mobile with cathy@example.com. Hero title renders at reduced size (48px desktop / 29.6px mobile) with no layout breakage. New DashboardActionBar (search + 6 shortcut tiles), at-a-glance panel (money-left + 3 mini-stat links), and the collapsible 'Budget detail, insights and history' toggle all work on both surfaces. Section ordering matches the requested pattern on both. Search + tile navigation route to the correct pages.

issues: 'LIFETIME CAP' label wraps and the '%' after '5' falls to a new line on 390px viewport — very minor, purely cosmetic

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardActionBar.jsx uses `h-4.5 w-4.5` and `mt-4.5` in a couple of places — these are non-standard Tailwind sizes and won't compile to real classes unless custom spacing is set. Icon size falls back but should be verified/replaced with `h-5 w-5` for consistency.

dashboardDestinations.js: `Key contacts` route is `/app?contacts=open` (query param, not a page). Search result click will land on /app but caregivers may not see the intended contacts drawer opening — worth a quick manual check.
CaregiverDashboard.jsx uses a native <details>/<summary> for the collapsible which is a11y-friendly and works, but the animated 'Show/Hide' state relies on `group-open:` classes — verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview: https://statement-checker-3.preview.emergentagent.com  Mobile Expo preview: https://aged-care-overhaul.expo.preview.emergentagent.com . On mobile login screen use placeholder-based selectors: page.get_by_placeholder('you@example.com') and get_by_placeholder('Your password'); Sign In is a Pressable — click via get_by_text('Sign In'). Dashboard testIDs verified: dashboard-action-bar, dashboard-action-search, dashboard-quick-actions, dashboard-action-result-0, dashboard-at-a-glance, glance-left/alerts/statements/cap, dashboard-more-detail (web details) / dashboard-more-detail-toggle (mobile), dashboard-more-detail-btn (web).
